limits: CUDA only: compiled out on HIP and MUSA builds (warp size 32, cudaStreamCreate), which keep the stock path
only calls with rows <= 8 and rows x blocks <= SM count use it (an in-kernel barrier needs every block resident); larger calls (prefill) keep the stock path

residency is derived from the SM count, not checked: not for MPS thread-percentage limits or green contexts (the barrier could hang); a faulted launch leaves the row state set and later calls on that stream hang
row state is keyed by stream handle only: a process that destroys a stream and gets the same handle on another GPU would reuse a buffer on the wrong device (single-GPU runs measured)
the order of picks above the threshold is the atomicAdd order, as in stock (no fixed order); ties fill the last slots in ascending column order, as in stock
keeps 8 x 128 bytes of zeroed device state per stream for the life of the process
